notes.title: Take a listen to tracks from the Wardialler soundtrack
notes.content:
Hello,

I've been working away at the soundtrack for a while and I've just finished another track.

https://soundcloud.com/nervous_testpilot/line-noise-wip

If you'd like to support my work on these, and on the game itself, then please take a look over here...

https://www.patreon.com/nervoustestpilot

Thanks!

notes.title: Wardialler Announced!
notes.content:
Thanks for your interest in Wardialler.

I'm currently working on the first version, which will be a free web-based game, and the soundtrack.  Both of those will be out soon.

If you want to follow along with development you can join the Wardialler channel on the Mode 7 Discord server here...

https://discord.gg/rvKJPWZ

I also have a Patreon if you'd like to support my music and development efforts...

https://www.patreon.com/nervoustestpilot
